response.answer: Jacob Cohen was a leading researcher in statistical power analysis, best known for his seminal book "Statistical Power Analysis for the Behavioral Sciences." He made significant contributions to behavioral sciences through his influential work on effect size and statistical power. His contributions remain essential in the field.
